mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, email, password, username, avatar, bio, role, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{password}, #{username}, #{avatar}, #{bio}, #{role}, #{status})
mapper.select:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.username, u.avatar, u.bio, u.occupation, u.role, u.status, u.created_at, u.last_login_at, u.last_login_ip, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE author_id = u.id) as article_count FROM users u
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', , '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR u.email LIKE CONCAT('%', , '%') ESCAPE '\\')
AND u.status = #{status}
ORDER BY u.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE users SET last_login_at = NOW(), last_login_ip = #{ip}, updated_at = updated_at WHERE id = #{id}
